templates.name: Specification API project bnd.bnd
templates.description: Minimal bnd.bnd for an OSGi specification API bundle: include layers, export all spec packages, annotation + provided framework buildpath. Note: ${p} and ${includes} are literal bnd macros, not template parameters.
templates.template:
# Set javac settings from JDT prefs
-include: ${includes}/jdt.bnd, ${includes}/${api-layer}.bnd

Export-Package: ${p}.*; -split-package:=first

-buildpath = \
    ${osgi.annotation.buildpath}, \
    org.osgi.framework;maven-scope=provided;version=${framework-version}

params.name: api-layer
params.description: Include layer selecting API level: core, cmpn, or companion

params.name: framework-version
params.description: org.osgi.framework package version the API compiles against

templates.name: Reference implementation project bnd.bnd
templates.description: bnd.bnd for a reference implementation bundle: activator, Export-Service, fully private packages. ${p} is the literal bnd project-package macro.
templates.template:
# Set javac settings from JDT prefs
-include: ${includes}/jdt.bnd, ${includes}/cmpn.bnd

Bundle-Activator			= ${p}.Activator
Bundle-Description			= ${description}

Export-Service				= ${service-interface}

-privatepackage 			= ${p}.*

-buildpath = \
	${api-project};version=latest, \
	org.osgi.framework;maven-scope=provided;version=1.8

params.name: service-interface
params.description: Fully qualified spec service interface the bundle registers

params.name: api-project
params.description: BSN of the sibling API project

templates.name: RI BundleActivator with ServiceFactory registration
templates.description: Activator registering the spec service as a ServiceFactory so each consuming bundle gets a scoped instance.

params.name: service-interface
params.description: Fully qualified service interface for import and registration name

params.name: service-type
params.description: Simple name of the service type parameter

templates.name: Versioned API package-info.java
templates.description: package-info.java carrying the semantic package version and consumer/provider import range documentation.

templates.name: TCK project bnd.bnd
templates.description: bnd.bnd for a TCK suite: support classes conditionally packaged, embedded test bundles, signature test, RI under test in -runbundles. ${p} and ${includes} are literal bnd macros; ${-signaturetest} is a literal bnd merged-instruction reference.
templates.template:
# Set javac settings from JDT prefs
-include: ${includes}/jdt.bnd, ${includes}/osgi.tck.junit-platform.bnd, ${includes}/tck.bnd, ${includes}/cmpn.bnd

Bundle-Description					: A test case for the ${spec-name} implementation.

-conditionalpackage					= org.osgi.test.support.*
-privatepackage						=  \
	${p}.junit
Import-Package: ${-signaturetest}, *

-includeresource					= \
	tb1.jar

-signaturetest                      = ${api-package}

-buildpath = \
    org.osgi.test.support;version=project, \
    org.osgi.framework;maven-scope=provided;version=1.8, \
    ${api-project};version=latest

-runbundles = \
	${impl-project}; version=latest

params.name: api-project
params.description: API project BSN on the buildpath

params.name: impl-project
params.description: Reference implementation BSN launched by the TCK run

templates.name: TCK test class on OSGiTestCase
templates.description: Spec-compliance test class: extends OSGiTestCase, exercises legal/illegal input matrices against the live framework.

params.name: scenario
params.description: Scenario suffix for the test method
